evidence_items.explanation: The study reports that combined interpretation exceeded both unaided readers and AI in its knee MRI experiment. This supports the claim for that task, with the important limitation that the AI assistance was simulated.

evidence_items.locator: Conclusion, paragraph discussing the optimal delegation policy
evidence_items.explanation: This radiologist experiment found that AI assistance did not uniformly improve diagnostic quality; its performance analysis also identified ranges where AI alone exceeded assisted radiologists. The delegation conclusion additionally accounts for reading time, so it is not a pure accuracy ranking.

unresolved_gaps: These studies do not establish a single ranking across all medical imaging tasks.
The supporting MRI experiment used simulated assistance, while the contrary study was a working paper.
